200.description:
The persisted saga state (200, not 201: a replay of the same
idempotency key returns the original transfer).

state.description:
The persisted saga state at response time — ALLOCATING
immediately after a fresh approval (awaiting inventory-storage's
reply). PICKED/IN_TRANSIT/ARRIVED/RECEIVED are driven later by
fulfillment-execution's transfer facts and inventory-storage's
destination facts (ADR 0005); RECEIVED is terminal.

originSiteId.description: Facility-layout Site code identifying one warehouse.
originSiteId.title: SiteID

destinationSiteId.description: Facility-layout Site code identifying one warehouse.
destinationSiteId.title: SiteID

reservationId.description: inventory-storage's reservation id, present once ALLOCATED.

rejectionReason.description: The closed rejection reason, present once UNFULFILLABLE.

replayed.description: True when the idempotency key already existed (the original transfer is returned).

expiresAt.description: The approval's expiry deadline (24h in v1).

transferLineId.description:
The v1 single transfer line id, "<transferId>:1" — the
inventory-storage allocation ledger key and the reply subject.
